A dramatic scene on a rocky mountain top. On the right, a large stone altar made of 12 stones is engulfed in bright, intense fire coming down from a clear sky. The fire is so intense it is burning the wet wood, the sacrifice, and the water in the trench around it. On the left, Elijah stands with one arm raised to the sky in prayer. In the foreground, a crowd of Israelites are falling on their faces in awe. In the background, the prophets of Baal look on in shock and defeat.
